application.name: VULCAN Ophthalmology System — Build an ROP screening workflow that
application.objective: Build an ROP screening workflow that uses gestational age, birth weight, retinal images and previous visits, flags high-risk infants, recommends follow-up, and requires clinician approval before any clinical action.

workflow.name: Ingest required data
workflow.action: Retrieve the required structured and unstructured inputs.

workflow.name: Evaluate patient state
workflow.action: Apply configured rules and models to generate a reviewable assessment.

workflow.name: Clinical review
workflow.action: Review assessment, evidence and proposed next action.

workflow.name: Record outcome
workflow.action: Persist approved result and audit metadata.

workflow.name: Coordinate follow-up
workflow.action: Prepare follow-up workflow after clinician approval.
